opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society junior scientist members: Scheme A – undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva; Schemes B & C – PhD student and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Applicants must be UK‑based for non‑UK meetings and present a poster or talk.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance at genetics‑related conferences (travel, accommodation, registration) for junior scientists, including virtual meetings.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK (or attending a UK‑based course). Students must be members; others need at least one year of membership.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to attend short genetics‑related training courses or collaborative laboratory visits.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK (or intending UK fieldwork). Applicants must be members; students need a supervisor who is also a member.
opportunities.summary: Covers travel, accommodation, subsistence and consumables for field‑based genetics research projects suitable for publication in Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, covering travel and material costs up to £1,000.
